bridge_archetype.scope: First of many possible vessels and bridge starts.

command_zone.empty_seat_policy: Seat remains spatially present and may show remote, absent, autonomous, or unoccupied state.

timeline_start.description: Begins from source-pinned human space technology and expands only through derived, simulated, or theoretical layers with explicit truth labels.

crew_start.description: A visible deterministic crew with a primary explorer and AI collaborator sharing the command zone.
crew_start.visibility_policy: All active seats and stations remain spatially represented even when represented by simple symbols.

applies_to: human command validity checks before execution
root_kernel_binding.override_policy: No seat, commander, vote, model, efficiency score, update, or visual layer can alter or bypass the roots.

crew_start.evolution_policy: Principles, practices, and strategies grow outward from immutable roots. Evolution is tested for root continuity rather than restrained by an unrelated after-the-fact guard.

ship_interior.scope: First ship interior; future vessels register independent room graphs.
semantic_rules: room focus does not become a generic website
future rooms require a new interior version or archetype
existing saves pin room graph and interaction versions
personal rooms may change appearance without changing recorded history

ship_blueprint.scope: Simulation and engineering reference architecture, not a manufactured or flight-certified spacecraft.

human_crew_active.rationale: Commander plus four human station specialists.

ai_collaborator_seats.rationale: Persistent room and command seat, no human metabolic load.

maximum_human_berths.rationale: One contingency berth above active human crew.

nominal_power_source_kw.note: Nameplate lineage reference, not payload-available power.

verified_delta_v_m_s.reason: Mass, propellant, Isp, thrust, and reserves are not pinned.

verified_mission_duration_days.reason: Depends on life support, maintenance, radiation, spares, mission and abort profile.

pressurized_volume_m3.rationale: Replaceable first-ship gameplay baseline; not a real vehicle dimension.

nominal_cabin_pressure_kpa.rationale: Earth-like demo baseline; mission profiles may choose other validated atmospheres.

dry_mass_kg.reason: No integrated structural and mass design exists.

rated_acceleration_m_s2.reason: Requires verified structural loads and propulsion configuration.

shield_areal_density_kg_m2.reason: Requires selected shield configuration and threat environment.

tracked_conjunction_avoidance_enabled.rationale: Simulator supports detected conjunctions; detection is environment-dependent.

reference_nameplate_power_kw.note: Gateway PPE lineage reference; not all power is payload-available.

nominal_availability_fraction.rationale: Models pointing, conversion, degradation, reserve, and losses.

usable_capacity_kwh.rationale: Simulation baseline for eclipse and fault decisions.

distribution_efficiency.rationale: System-level assumption; actual requires converter and wiring design.

nominal_rejection_capacity_kw.rationale: Simulation baseline coupled to first-ship power budget.

propulsion_lineage.value: Gateway-like solar-electric platform plus chemical contingency capability
propulsion_lineage.rationale: Functional lineage only; not an integrated design.

specific_impulse_s.reason: Must come from selected reviewed thruster and operating point.

actuator_inventory.rationale: Exact effectors depend on future ship version.

functions: estimate position velocity attitude and rates
point antennas sensors radiators and arrays

state_vector_dimensions.note: Position and velocity; attitude tracked separately.

navigation_uncertainty_model.rationale: First model; future may use covariance and SPICE.

command_authority_model.rationale: AXM layer on conventional C&DH functions.

data_rate_bps.reason: Depends on band, gains, power, coding, range, weather, and allocation.

active_human_crew.rationale: Commander plus four human station specialists.

oxygen_recovery_reference_fraction.note: Sabatier-era reference context; future systems may differ.

emergency_suited_duration_h.note: Orion lineage reference; not verified for the integrated AXM ship.

systems.display_name: Water Recovery, Potable Supply, and Waste Management

demonstrated_reference_recovery_fraction.note: ISS milestone reference; not guaranteed for this ship.

simulation_nominal_recovery_fraction.rationale: Conservative simulation value below cited milestone.

stored_potable_water_kg.rationale: Scenario design value, not flight manifest.

systems.display_name: Fire Detection, Suppression, and Emergency Response
functions: detect smoke heat and combustion products

zone_count.rationale: One logical emergency zone per room cluster.

medical_dose_model_available.rationale: No medical absorbed-dose prediction is claimed.

docking_interface.rationale: Models compatibility goal without certification claim.

systems.display_name: External Navigation, Environment, and Science Sensors

raw_data_preservation.rationale: Derived products never replace original measurements.

claim_ceiling_enforced.rationale: Existing AXM evidence architecture remains authoritative.

systems.display_name: Crew Health, Medical, and Human Performance Support

validated_psychology_model.rationale: Records reports and workload; does not calculate minds.

crew_medical_officer_required.rationale: First crew carries a secondary CMO profile.

systems.display_name: Integrated Fault Detection, Isolation, Response, and Recovery

credible_single_fault_coverage_target.rationale: Architecture target, not verified coverage claim.

not_in_v1: damage numbers detached from ship systems

experience_contract.purpose: Protect the lived-in vessel experience without hardcoding one ship, crew, era, or timeline.

extensibility_rule.new_ship: register a new vessel archetype id and version
extensibility_rule.new_room: register a new bridge grammar id and version
extensibility_rule.new_timeline: register a new timeline start id and version
extensibility_rule.new_crew: register a new crew manifest id and version
extensibility_rule.existing_save: pins the exact ids and versions used at creation
extensibility_rule.visual_upgrade: may change renderer and skin, not pinned semantic anchors
extensibility_rule.breaking_room_change: requires a new archetype version; never silently migrates old saves

first_bridge_is_one_of_many: First of many possible vessels and bridge starts.
